detail: Named gap in this bundle's own gate design: when an acceptance criterion is refuted (e.g. C2.1/C2.2's epic-breakdown.md acceptance command literally returning 0/not-reproducing, retro id 1789886083389-epic-c2-test-rewrite-6b6500) and the fix agent's own disposition is to decline fixing it in that cycle (defer, escalate, or leave for a later dispatch), a gate that only re-runs 'is the suite green' on the next cycle sees green and proceeds -- it never re-checks that the SPECIFIC refuted criterion was actually cleared, not merely that nothing new broke. The mechanical fix: a refuted criterion must be tracked as its own named item (not folded into 'green suite') and the gate must re-test that exact item, not a proxy for it; a decline on a named criterion halts the run for an operator ruling, per AGENTS.md 'Blocker Discipline', rather than being silently carried forward as an all-green cycle.
summary: A workflow gate that only re-checks 'verify green' after a refuted criterion lets a declined criterion through -- a refuted criterion the fix agent declines must stop the run
